remarks:
A Beautiful Slice of Country Living with Endless Possibilities! This exceptional 10.07-acre parcel in the Town of Newstead offers a rare opportunity to create your own private retreat while enjoying the highly desirable Clarence Central School District and the benefit of Newstead’s lower property taxes.
Surrounded by natural beauty, this property offers a wonderful combination of wooded areas and open space, providing privacy, peace, and plenty of room to bring your vision to life. Whether you dream of building a custom home, establishing a small equestrian property, creating a hunting retreat, or simply having acreage to explore and enjoy, this property offers tremendous potential.
Nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the opportunity for hiking, exploring, wildlife watching, and ATV recreation. Imagine having your own private piece of the countryside where you can enjoy the changing seasons and the beauty of nature right outside your door.
Public water, electric, telephone, cable, and high-speed internet are available at the road, making this an especially attractive opportunity for those looking to build.
Despite its peaceful, private setting, the property is conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, golf courses, and other everyday amenities, with an easy commute to Buffalo, Rochester, and Batavia.
10.07 acres, desirable schools, lower Newstead taxes, available utilities, and endless possibilities—bring your dreams and make them a reality! Also listed as divided in preliminary survey B1705377-Lot#1 31.55 Acres, B1705383-Lot#2 10.07 Acres, B1705407-Lot#4 20.63 Acres or B1705377 entire large parcel of 72.32 Acres
